name: Nutrition SC Public Company Limited
summary: Nutrition SC Public Company Limited specializes in the manufacturing and supply of a diverse range of food ingredients and condiments. Their extensive product line features food colorants, flavor enhancers, texturizing agents, specialized ingredients for anti-aging, skin health, and cardiovascular well-being, various sweetening solutions, and stabilizing compounds. These offerings are utilized across numerous segments of the food and beverage industry, including bakery items, beverages, confectionery, dietary supplements, pharmaceuticals, meat products, sauces, seasonings, flour and starch-based goods, and dairy selections. Established in 1981, the company is headquartered in Nakhon Pathom, Thailand.
